╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

Usage:
  Sirocco.exe <input file path> [options]

  Note: The input file path must be the first argument. Options can follow in any order.

  If run without arguments, interactive mode starts.

Options:

[Basic Renaming]
  --rename             Enable basic renaming (private fields/methods/nested types).
                       This is a prerequisite for type/namespace renaming.
  --rename-types       Rename class names (non-public classes; if --public is set, all classes).
                       Requires --rename.
  --rename-namespaces  Rename namespaces (may affect reflection/serialization).
                       Requires --rename.
  --public             Obfuscate public/protected members (may break external calls).
                       Requires --rename.

[Encryption]
  --strings            Use XOR encryption, lightweight.
  --stringsAES         Use AES-256 encryption (dynamic per-string keys), more secure.

  --res-enc            Encrypt embedded resources (e.g., images, configs) and decrypt at runtime.

[Control Flow Obfuscation]
  --controlflow        Enable control flow obfuscation (switch flattening + opaque predicates + jump mangling),
                       significantly increasing reverse‑engineering difficulty.

  --ref-proxy          Enable reference proxy (experimental), hides direct method call relationships.

  --antidebug          Inject anti‑debug protection (detects Debugger.IsAttached), silently exits when debugged.
